value: US Government work (DOE Office of Manufacturing and Energy Supply Chains / Industrial Assessment Centers), public domain

U.S. Department of Energy, Industrial Assessment Centers (2024). Decarbonization Tipsheet 3: Replace Conventional Boiler with Electric Boiler. Office of Manufacturing and Energy Supply Chains (energy.gov/mesc), dated 1/11/24, 6 pp.

Loaded: electric boiler general data (size up to 240 MMBtu/hr or 70 MWe, efficiency 95-99%, capex 14,000-47,000 2018$/MMBtu/hr for 10-250 MMBtu/hr plus derived $/kW, power-law capex equation in the formula column, O&M 1%/yr) and fossil boiler efficiency 70-85%; worked example (10 MMBtu/hr, 70% gas boiler vs 99% electric boiler, 6,000 h/yr, capex $467,200, O&M $4,672/yr, 20 yr, 5%, LCAC $1,106/tCO2). Example energy prices, grid factors and annual totals in _other-values. Not loaded: state map of grid intensity (Fig. 1, chart only). Locator: printed page numbers (footer), equal to PDF pages. Traps: all cost data are reprinted from Zuberi et al. 2021 (LBNL, Electrification of Boilers in U.S. Manufacturing), the same group as zuberi_2022_002, so the capex range duplicates that source; cost basis not stated here. LCAC mixes 2018$ capex with 2021 energy prices; unit written with publication year 2024. Gas emission factor 0.05306 t/MMBtu is per fuel input; a derived per-output row is also given. Several equations are images and did not extract as text; values taken from the printed results.
